applied.problem: "Makers rate ... at a 20-hour discharge" drops the source's "commonly" (standby battery-room cells are often rated at 8 or 10 hours); "Two things cause the shortfall" is more exclusive than the lesson can support; Victron's monitor default (1.25) is one maker's, not every monitor's.
25 × 2.3 is 57.5, not 58 (58 comes from the unrounded 2.33 h); and load-profile sizing usually works from makers' rate tables, not Peukert's arithmetic, so "rests on this arithmetic" overstates it.
"A cable's resistance stays put" is not true: a copper conductor's resistance rises with its temperature, which an electrician knows from cable sizing; narrow it to "changes only a little".
